Class BlockUsage

java.lang.Object
org.applecommander.usage.DiskUsage
org.applecommander.usage.BlockUsage
public class BlockUsage extends DiskUsage
Provides block-level usage information. Note that block size can vary from 256 bytes (RDOS) to 512 bytes (Pascal, ProDOS) to 1024 bytes (CP/M), so it must be passed in on the constructor.
